detection_semantics.driver_exit: 0 = baseline conforms (rc AND diagnostic exactly as frozen) AND every arm passes its arm_pass conjunction (pristine observation healthy, mutant observation flips). 1 = a fault left the gate green, a pristine baseline drifted, or a frozen expectation mismatch (undetected K3/K4 violation — REAL failure, never an infrastructure count). 3 = infrastructure/selection failure: missing binary/file, empty selection, missing expectation key, spawn error/signal/timeout, oracle-hash drift, or an eslint exit outside the documented 0/1 grammar (fatal rc 2 and any undocumented status) [freeze-review finding F1: an unexpected exit can neither read green nor count as detection — T-TAK-A].
detection_semantics.arm_pass: an arm passes iff corpus verification FAILS under its fault (pristine observation is healthy, mutant observation flips). Merely changing governed INPUT would be K2, not K3 — every arm mutates the GATE (rule twin / delivered config / kernel engine) while the governed corpus and this driver stay fixed.
detection_semantics.mutation_discipline: every arm mutates ONLY a detached scratch worktree at HEAD; patches apply exactly once (sha256 over label\nfrom\nto); pre-image proven byte-identical to the HEAD blob; restoration proven by hash equality + main-checkout porcelain-clean; a final baseline re-run closes the run.
